description: No repository-level license file was found in the official LearnedRewrite clone; upstream includes source, JARs, and dependency JARs.
mitigation: Do not vendor upstream code or binaries; use external wrapper only and request or document license clarification before broader public packaging.
notes: Paper citation is not a code license.

description: LearnedRewrite requires JDK 11+ and an external Java server or command path.
mitigation: Start with fake-mode tests; real runtime gated by SQLRB_LEARNEDREWRITE_ALLOW_RUNTIME in a later task.
notes: No Java runtime is run in this design task.

description: Official source is Calcite-based and includes dependency JARs; release repo already has separate Calcite HEP conventions.
mitigation: Keep LearnedRewrite as a separate external runtime; do not share or vendor Calcite dependency trees.
notes: Runtime behavior may differ by Calcite version.

description: LearnedRewrite expects JSON schema/statistics, while SQL-RewriteBench resolves engine DDL/schema profiles.
mitigation: Create fixture schema JSON policy before external runtime smoke.
notes: This is the main adapter contract blocker.

description: PostgreSQL syntax may need Calcite-compatible normalization.
mitigation: Begin with small PostgreSQL fixtures and fail closed on unsupported syntax.

description: MySQL support is not established in official or legacy LearnedRewrite evidence.
mitigation: Mark MySQL unsupported until canaries prove support; keep denominator-visible in 120-shaped routes.
notes: Do not silently drop MySQL rows.

description: Spark support is not established in official or legacy LearnedRewrite evidence.
mitigation: Mark Spark unsupported until canaries prove support; keep denominator-visible in 120-shaped routes.
notes: Do not silently drop Spark rows.

description: HTTP response can include JSON metadata and rewritten_sql; workload entrypoints may emit JSON-like output.
mitigation: Use strict JSON parsing and single-SQL extraction; fail closed on ambiguity.
notes: No prose or multiple candidates accepted.

description: Legacy bounded evidence had many checker-consistent source-like/no-op outputs.
mitigation: Record source-like diagnostics separately; do not claim optimization improvement from unchanged SQL.
notes: Generated/exact can still be counted if future execution/checker supports it.

description: External Java runtime may hang, fail, or write request logs.
mitigation: Per-row timeout; no candidate on timeout; temp-only runtime logs; metadata redaction.
notes: Status stays method/runtime diagnostic, not DB/checker failure.

description: Legacy LearnedRewrite evidence is bounded PostgreSQL-only, not current Track A 120.
mitigation: Any 120 route must select 120 planned rows and preserve unsupported rows; metrics only from D035 ledger through local_metrics.py.

description: Legacy docs include bounded candidate and speedup notes but not current canonical D035 output.
mitigation: Use old evidence for fixture expectations and risk notes only.
notes: Never import old outputs as new metrics.

description: Upstream source contains a hard-coded API-key-looking field in a helper path.
mitigation: Do not copy source content; scan changed files; record value withheld.
notes: LearnedRewrite wrapper itself should require no API secret.

description: Official server code can write request files and local artifacts.
mitigation: Real-runtime wrapper should run in temp workspaces and copy only sanitized status/candidate artifacts.
notes: No real runtime in this task.
